steps.instruction: Sprinkle 1 teaspoon of yeast over 2/3 cup of warm water in a large bowl.
steps.spoken: Sprinkle 1 teaspoon of yeast over the surface of 2/3 cup of warm water in a large bowl. Let it stand for 1 minute.

steps.instruction: Stir the yeast and water until the yeast dissolves.
Mix in 2 cups of flour, 1 teaspoon of salt and 2 tablespoons of olive oil.
Turn the dough out onto a floured surface once it is too thick to stir.

steps.spoken: Knead the dough for 5 minutes. Knead in a little more flour if the dough is too sticky.

steps.instruction: Put the dough in an oiled bowl and cover it.
Set the bowl in a warm place until the dough has doubled in size.
Preheat the oven to 550 °F, or as hot as your oven will go.
steps.spoken: Preheat the oven to 550 °F, or as hot as your oven will go. If you use a pizza stone, preheat it in the oven too, on the lowest shelf.

steps.instruction: Flatten the risen dough on a lightly floured surface.
Roll or stretch the dough into a 12-inch circle on a baking sheet.
steps.spoken: Roll or stretch the dough into a 12-inch circle and put it on a baking sheet. If you use a pizza stone, you can put the pizza on a piece of parchment paper while the stone heats.

steps.instruction: Spread 1 can of tomato sauce evenly over the dough.
Sprinkle on 1 tablespoon oregano, 1 pound mozzarella and 1/4 cup basil.
Sprinkle on 1/2 cup of Romano cheese and 1 teaspoon of red pepper flakes.
Bake the pizza for 12 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
steps.spoken: Bake for 12 to fifteen minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbly and the bottom of the crust is browned when you lift the edge a little.

steps.instruction: Let the pizza cool for 5 minutes before slicing.
